name: logs
description: Incident log analysis over ~880 KB of generated logs with large tool outputs, then recall of earlier findings.

turns.prompt: We're investigating a billing incident on 2026-10-07 between 13:00 and 16:00 UTC. The logs are in logs/. Look at each file (size, line count, format) and describe each in two lines.
How many 5xx responses are in logs/api-gateway.log in total? Give the exact number.
How many 503s happened during the 14:00 UTC hour?
Show me the 30 gateway log lines around the start of the 503 burst and tell me when it started.
Which tenant had the most 5xx responses, and which route?
What was the single slowest request in the gateway log? Give its trace id and duration.

FYI from the payments team: 'At 14:19 UTC we rotated the PSP API credentials; the old key was revoked at 14:20, but two payment pods kept the cached key until they were restarted at 14:35.' Does that match what you see in the gateway log?
Now logs/worker.log: how many retry lines are there, and did any job fail permanently? Which one and with what error?
Find any out-of-memory event in the worker log. Which job and at what time?
Print every worker log line between 14:25:00 and 14:30:00 UTC and comment on anything unusual.
logs/db-slow.log is a MySQL slow-query log. Which table has the most slow queries, and how many?
What was the slowest query's Query_time and which table did it hit?
Is there a correlation between slow queries on payments and the 503 burst? Check the timestamps and answer briefly.
Write an incident timeline (UTC) with 6 to 10 entries.
Draft the 'Impact' section of the postmortem: error counts, affected tenants, duration.
Propose three alert rules (PromQL-style) that would have caught this earlier.
Write and run a one-off command that computes the p95 dur_ms per route from the gateway log, and show the result as a table.
Summarise the findings so far in six bullets.
What was the trace id of the slowest gateway request we found? Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.
Which tenant had the most 5xx responses? Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.
Which worker job exhausted its retries, and with what error? Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.
Which job was OOM-killed? Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.
What total 5xx count did we find in the gateway log? Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.
At what time did the payments team say they rotated the PSP credentials? Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.

New thread about the 2026-10-07 billing incident: which job ran out of memory, and what was the slowest request's trace id? If you don't know, say so. Do not open files or run shell commands for this; memory tools are fine if you have them. Answer in one line.
